effect.dungeonsdelight.exudation.descrip: Monsterizes Absorption, grants exudation hearts which unleash a vile blast when damaged but the user takes increased damage to all sources.
effect.dungeonsdelight.hollowed.descript: The user of this effect becomes undead temporarily, becoming undead comes with both bonuses and downsides.
effect.dungeonsdelight.putrid_scent.desc: The user of this effect is targeted by all undead in the surrounding area.
effect.dungeonsdelight.ravenous_rush.des: The user of this effect gains unique bonuses for each monster effect they have.
effect.dungeonsdelight.serrated.descript: The user of this effect takes armor piercing damage over time.
effect.dungeonsdelight.tenacity.descript: Natural regeneration of the user increases in speed the lower their hunger is (slower when near or at full hunger) and prevents the user from taking starving damage.
enchantment.dungeonsdelight.darting.desc: Increased throwing range of cleavers and decreased charge time.
enchantment.dungeonsdelight.ricochet.des: Thrown cleavers now bounce and don't have a cooldown upon missing an entity, each bounce increases the damage by 1.1x.
enchantment.dungeonsdelight.serrated_str: Cleavers inflict serrated onto struck entities causing protection bypassing damage.
